# The painted skies (Synthwave, Moonlight) at a low render distance and with clouds, fix/sky115 (1280x720, GUI scale 2 as
# the test world starts: render distance 6, clouds fancy). The painted sky marks itself as nearer than anything behind
# it, at 0.74 to 0.81 of the render distance; the lyrics in the Sky sit at up to 0.8 of it, and vanilla draws its clouds
# after the sky, out to their own reach (on 26.3 the painted sky marks nothing, so there neither happens).
# 1. sky115-rd8 / -rd5 / -rd4 / -rd2 (See through blocks off, the Lines layout, Distance 64, lyrics to the north with the
#    synthwave sun to their right): with the old code the lyrics show whole at render distance 8, but at 5 and 4 the
#    sun, its halo and the ends of the rows (more than about 9 degrees off their middle) cover them, and at 2 they are
#    gone behind the sky. On the branch the whole lines show at every render distance.
#    sky115-rd4-seethrough (See through on) shows the whole lines on both: the lines that should be there.
# 2. sky115-clouds-rd12-synthwave / -moonlight (render distance 12, clouds fancy, looking up to the south): with the old
#    code the clouds end in a hard circle about 55 degrees up, with none below it; on the branch they reach down towards
#    the horizon as on sky115-clouds-rd12-aurora (the vanilla night sky, the same on both). sky115-clouds-rd6-synthwave
#    (render distance 6): with the old code no clouds at all; on the branch the same clouds as on the Aurora shot.
# Run it, and with -f mod_ref=main to compare with the old code:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/sky115 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/sky115.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/sky115 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/sky115.txt

# A clear night that stays night; the lyrics pinned to the north, the synthwave sun just to their right
cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set direction NORTH
set sky SYNTHWAVE
set skyStrength 0.7
set shootingStars false
set twinkle false
set skyPulse false
set layout LINES
set placement SKY
set seeThroughBlocks false
look 180 -22
option renderDistance 8
sleep 10
shot sky115-rd8

# 1. Lower render distances: the sky comes nearer than the lyrics
option renderDistance 5
sleep 6
shot sky115-rd5
option renderDistance 4
sleep 6
shot sky115-rd4
set seeThroughBlocks true
sleep 3
shot sky115-rd4-seethrough
set seeThroughBlocks false
option renderDistance 2
sleep 6
shot sky115-rd2

# 2. Clouds over the painted skies, looking up away from the lyrics
set seeThroughBlocks true
option clouds fancy
option renderDistance 12
look 0 -40
sleep 12
shot sky115-clouds-rd12-synthwave
set sky AURORA
sleep 6
shot sky115-clouds-rd12-aurora
set sky MOONLIGHT
sleep 6
shot sky115-clouds-rd12-moonlight
set sky SYNTHWAVE
option renderDistance 6
sleep 6
shot sky115-clouds-rd6-synthwave

# Back as the test world starts
set sky AURORA
set layout WORLD
set direction FOLLOW
look 0 -28
sleep 2
